summary: The main article describes an electrolyte- and base-free electrochemical cobalt-catalyzed C-H annulation for the synthesis of N-N axially chiral isoquinolinones. It includes a design blueprint (Fig. 1), an optimization table (Table 1), a broad substrate scope (Scheme 1), and mechanistic studies (Scheme 3).

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.caption: Background and design blueprint.
items.description: This figure illustrates the challenges of N-N atropisomer synthesis and the design of the electrolyte-free electrochemical cobalt-catalyzed C-H annulation strategy.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Reaction development a
items.description: This table details the optimization of reaction conditions, including the screening of electrolytes, current density, atmosphere, and the discovery of electrolyte-free conditions.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: Scope of electrocatalytic atroposelective C -H annulation.
items.description: This scheme demonstrates the substrate scope for various alkynes and benzamides, showing the yields and enantioselectivities of the resulting N-N axially chiral isoquinolinones.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: Synthetic utilizations.
items.description: This scheme shows the derivatization of the synthesized products, including halogenation and conversion to thiocarbonyl groups.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: Mechanistic insights and plausible pathway.
items.description: This scheme provides mechanistic details including H/D scrambling experiments, cyclic voltammetry data, and the proposed catalytic cycle for the electrochemical process.
